osys1200.name: OSYS1200 - Operating Systems
osys1200.subtitle: Windows Lab Virtual Machine
osys1200.description: Start, monitor, and connect to your dedicated OSYS1200 Windows lab virtual machine.
notes: Your VM ID is your NSCC Student ID without the leading 'W0' (e.g., W01234567 becomes 1234567).
Recommended: Download the .rdp connection file once the VM is running and has acquired an IP address.
Console Access: SPICE console requires Virt-Viewer (`winget install RedHat.VirtViewer`).

netw2710.name: NETW2710 - Network Infrastructure
netw2710.subtitle: Network Systems Lab VM
netw2710.description: Access your assigned virtual machine for NETW2710 network administration and Linux exercises.
notes: Your VM ID is your NSCC Student ID without the leading 'W0' (e.g., W01234567 becomes 1234567).
Console Access: SPICE console requires Virt-Viewer (`winget install RedHat.VirtViewer`).
